summary: The weekly limits policy can exempt accounts and harnesses, and the daemon reads its [limits] config again on every pass

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: config.toml [limits] accepts the optional exempt_accounts and exempt_harnesses lists; an older build rejects a config that names them. st usage prints an EXEMPT line and marks exempt accounts, and st --json usage adds an exempt flag to each limit and a limits_policy object. Both are additive.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required. The limits policy now reads [limits] on every two-minute pass, so later edits apply without a restart.

manual.detail: No action is required. Operators may replace a hand-made keep list for an account with exempt_accounts.

recovery.detail: Only configuration reading changes; reverting restores the one-time read at daemon start.
